note: Triennial election of Limavady rural district (23 divisions); Co. Londonderry polled 31 October 1946. Seven divisions were contested; six new members and ten retiring councillors were returned unopposed (Londonderry Sentinel, 19 October 1946, p. 6). The Sentinel of 2 November 1946, p. 5, prints the results and the full new council of 23 names, without divisions; the Nationalists won control for the first time. Seven of the retiring members' divisions are taken from the 1939 return, as each contest note says. Faughanvale added and the six unopposed new members re-cited (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Citation corrected (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026): the six unopposed new members are printed in the Londonderry Sentinel (19 October 1946, p. 6) and the Derry Journal (18 October 1946, p. 7), not on the News-Letter page cited before. No party label is printed with them; the 'U.' formerly recorded is removed. Returned unopposed.
